summary: Busy parked-up kerb with apartment blocks behind it and homes opposite.
reasons: No Stopping signs somewhere along it

drivers.seclusion: Apartment car park and blocks behind the kerb; flats and houses across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park nose to tail along the kerb, so there is room beside the lane.
drivers.convention: Many cars parked on both sides; two No Stopping Any Time signs on the stretch.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at 0.7 m and 12.5 m from the kerb line; check where they apply
Low-lying: 4.6 to 5.6 m elevation, mapped waterway 41 m away
Apartments 12 m from the kerb at 87 m, outside the best section
sun_shade: Tree cover over the middle; apartment blocks shade the north side in the morning.
cannot_judge: Where the No Stopping signs apply

best_section.where: Macquarie Street north kerb, beside the apartment block car park
